records.text: Owens said Netanyahu called Charlie Kirk during the August 4–6 Hamptons retreat with Erika present; she guessed August 4, said unnamed sources reported an offer to elevate TPUSA and an Israel invitation that Charlie declined, and believed Kolvet had admitted the invitation.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: On August 3rd, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Erika (Erika Kirk) land in Bedford, New York, for the Hamptons retreat. From the 4th to the 6th, there's this, like, you know, between the intervention. We don't know specifically which day Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) called. My ... My best guess would be on the 4th, I'm telling you. The 5th and the 6th is when the influencers are there. ... They were not a part of this meeting. They were not a part of Bibi Netanyahu (Benjamin Netanyahu) calling, but it's now since been confirmed that Bibi Netanyahu (Benjamin Netanyahu) did in fact call. Erika (Erika Kirk) was present for this phone call, and I was told that he offered to take Turning Point to the next level. ... In exchange for what was never made clear. I was also told that Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) invited Charlie (Charlie Kirk) to Israel, and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) declined to go to Israel. I believe that Andrew Kolvet has since admitted to that.
